name: Michelle Bloom
source:
One of the members of the school's newspaper club. Her family also acts as the host family for Anuja. She's a bright student, though a bit sneaky and conniving at times. She and Anuja host a D&D group at her house that [url=https://vndb.org/c174075]Katrina[/url], Emily, and sometimes [url=https://vndb.org/c174069]John[/url] attend.
